quote: OpenAI released GPT-6 Astra on 3 September 2026 at $10 per million input tokens and $50 per million output tokens.
note: Lab and kind notes confirmed: OpenAI, shipped model. The date is the day of OpenAI's launch, but day-one access was limited: the source says "Astra is rolling out to a limited set of organisations" and that "access starts with enterprise customers in the Daybreak programme before paid ChatGPT plans and the API follow." I did not find a dated general-availability sentence in any page I opened, so 2026-09-03 is recorded as the release date and the strict public-availability date is not settled. A vorplabs.com page (opened, summarized by the fetch tool, so quotes may not be verbatim) says OpenAI released gpt-6-astra on September 3, 2026 on the Responses and Chat Completions APIs, citing an API changelog entry, and says no general-availability declaration had been found as of October 7, 2026. The same page lists Amazon Bedrock on September 8, 2026 and OpenRouter on September 4, 2026 (UTC); those are distributor dates, not OpenAI's. Not verified: the September 4 date for paid ChatGPT plans and the API appears only in unopened search summaries. The OpenAI primary pages (openai.com/index/gpt-6-astra/ and openai.com/blog/path-to-astra/) returned HTTP 403 to the fetch tool, so the launch post and system card were not read. The constellationr.com article was published September 3, 2026 but does not state the release date in its text. implicator.ai (published September 2, 2026) describes Astra as unreleased with "no launch date", which is consistent with a September 3 launch.
